lines.text: Leaving the dock, CONTINUA slides from cable to Wi-Fi without a gap. The rover beside it isn't so lucky.
The other rover has no CONTINUA. Same road, same signal. It only switches after its network fails.
CONTINUA's road map shows where coverage drops. Seventy-nine metres out, it starts warming up satellite.
In the cutting, CONTINUA is already on satellite. The other rover loses its link, and has to stop.
One operator kept the link. The other was cut off for four and a half seconds.
One run could be luck, so every strategy drove this road twenty times. With its road map, CONTINUA kept the link every time, at about a third of the cost of keeping every network on.
CONTINUA. Predictive network continuity, by Team Kanban.
